title: Writer Assistant Core review queue storage and owner-review workflow planning
goal: Publish the planning and contract parent that decides whether and how the in-memory review queue entries produced by the completed PHASE8-IMPL-011 candidate review gate should be stored, listed, loaded, and prepared for future owner-review workflows without turning queue state into approval, canon truth, apply-promotion, review UI/API scope creep, or memory/canon mutation, and without implementing review queue storage, owner actions, UI/API, or routes in T001.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-011 is complete through T007 and delivered backend/story_knowledge/candidate_review_gate.py plus an in-memory review queue entry builder (build_review_queue_entry), candidate-only persistence through existing helpers, and contract tests, with no review queue storage/listing, no review UI/API, no owner action workflow beyond undecided/pending metadata, no apply-promotion, no memory/canon mutation, and no runtime extraction. The review queue entry is built in memory only; it is not stored, listed, or loaded yet. The next risk is accidental queue storage, review UI/API, owner action workflow, or apply-promotion without an explicit contract.

Review UI/API planning boundary decision without implementing UI.

safety_notes: Owner review remains mandatory before anything can become approved truth.
Review queue entries are workflow support only and are not candidate approval, canon, memory, owner decisions, or promotion.
Queue presence, grouping, sorting, priority, confidence, or source count does not imply approval or canon truth.
Review queue storage is not authorized unless a later owner-approved child explicitly defines a queue storage contract.
An owner action workflow is a review surface, not apply-promotion, and owner action storage is not memory/canon mutation.
T001 is docs/status/planning only and adds no code, tests, routes, UI, package changes, review queue storage, owner action workflow, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation.

context_tools_policy: No CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context, MCP tools, or LeanCTX were authorized or run for T001.
external_tool_policy: No external tools were installed, cloned, fetched, pulled, executed, imported, copied, or vendored in T001.
candidate_record_policy: Candidate records remain candidate-only and review-pending and never become canon, memory, owner decisions, or promotion by default. This parent does not modify candidate schema/record/storage/persistence/list/index modules.
review_queue_policy: Review queue entries are workflow support only, not approval, canon, memory, storyform truth, owner decisions, generated prose, or apply-promotion. T001 does not implement queue storage, listing, UI/API, routes, owner actions, or persistence.
queue_storage_policy: Whether and how review queue entries are stored, listed, loaded, and prepared for future owner review is decided and tested in later children before any queue storage helper, route, or UI exists. Any future queue storage must be project-local, candidate-linked, candidate-only, review-workflow-only, and must preserve evidence/provenance, with no approval/canon/memory writes, no apply-promotion, no duplication of candidate truth, and no route/UI side effects. T001 does not implement queue storage.
owner_action_policy: Owner action workflow states and commands are defined as planning terms only in later children. Owner actions are not apply-promotion and owner action storage is not memory/canon mutation. T001 does not implement owner actions.
owner_review_policy: Owner review is mandatory before queue entries or candidate records can become approved truth.
apply_promotion_policy: Apply-promotion remains unimplemented and is not authorized by this parent.
memory_canon_policy: No memory/canon mutation is authorized by this parent.
no_runtime_extraction_policy: No real BookNLP/spaCy runtime, extraction tool execution, backend extraction route, frontend extraction UI, or package/dependency change is authorized by T001.
no_generated_prose_policy: No generated prose, rewrite, continuation, imitation, polish, improvement, or expansion is authorized by this parent.
